summary: Verified bug fix for 'Sessione terminata' regression on anonymous re-login after leaving /terms unaccepted. Scenario A (auth-guard redirect): anonymous login → /terms → programmatic navigation back to /auth → user was AUTO-REDIRECTED to /terms as intended (no error shown). Scenario B (public-path guard regression): fresh anonymous login and post-clear-token anonymous login BOTH succeed and land on /terms without 'Sessione terminata'. Scenario C (backend regression): POST /api/auth/anonymous, GET /api/legal/terms, GET /api/legal/nda all return 200 with expected payload shape. No React Native deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues detected in the two edited files. Only pre-existing web console warnings ('shadow*' / 'textShadow*' / props.pointerEvents deprecated) surfaced — unrelated to this fix.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx useEffect correctly mirrors index.tsx routing table; guards against re-submission race by redirecting as soon as AuthContext resolves a user with terms_accepted=false.

api.ts guard change is sound: `(_isLoggedOut || !token) && requiresAuth(path)` correctly whitelists PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES so /auth/anonymous, /auth/login, /legal/* always fire — resolves the false-positive 'Sessione terminata'.
Minor pre-existing warning noise on web ('shadow*'/'textShadow*'/props.pointerEvents deprecated) — unrelated, tracked elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: Created three throwaway anonymous users via /api/auth/anonymous during the flow (test_regr_1, test_agent_*, test_fresh_*, test_relog_*). No cleanup needed — anonymous users are self-scoped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. If regression re-appears, first confirm /api/auth/anonymous is still in PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES in /app/frontend/src/api.ts and that auth.tsx useEffect still redirects to /terms when user.terms_accepted !== true. The web preview uses expo-secure-store which stores via localStorage — clearing localStorage is the reliable way to simulate a fresh no-token state in Playwright.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was in /app/frontend/src/api.ts request() guard: `((_isLoggedOut && !token) || (!token && requiresAuth(path)))`. First branch fired whenever _isLoggedOut was true AND token was absent — for ANY path including public /auth/anonymous. After the user backed out of /terms without accepting, AuthContext still held a stale user snapshot but /auth mounted, so re-submitting anonymous went through, but any earlier logout state or race could trip the guard on the public path. Fix scopes the short-circuit to requiresAuth(path). Additionally auth.tsx now redirects on-mount to the correct pending screen so the user doesn't re-submit a second anonymous account and confuse state. Verified via full end-to-end Playwright flow.
